title: Page 1
summary: A 1956 CIA memorandum (Subproject 42 of MKULTRA) describes a facility for covertly dosing unwitting subjects with physiologically active materials, set up via a safehouse and funds given to Mr. ___. Individuals who covertly administer materials are paid small cash sums irregularly, with no receipts possible due to risk. These expenditures appear as cash withdrawals, each operation reported to the Chief, TSS/Chemical Division, with approval on monthly accounting. Signed by Sidney Gottlieb.
